name: monopole
title: Monopole
description: Scores and judges your coding-agent sessions in CES, and proposes reviewed changes to your agent instructions.

prerequisites.purpose: Supplies the Python and the locked packages Monopole runs with.

actions.name: status
actions.title: Status
actions.description: Prints Prompting Time's status format 2: whether runs are running, the providers a recent check found signed out, and the newest 50 runs that are not drafts. Reads files only.

actions.name: runs
actions.title: List runs
actions.description: Prints the newest runs as JSON, with each run's session, judges, mean rating, failure cause, and how its proposal compared with the current instructions. Reads files only.

actions.name: run
actions.title: Show a run
actions.description: Prints one run as JSON, given --item <run id>: its card, stages, rubric ratings, and models, plus every field Monopole's web UI reads for a run: selection and pinned settings, each stage's progress and events, judge attempts and failures, and reflection evidence. Reads files only.

actions.name: delete
actions.title: Delete run
actions.description: Deletes a run that is not running from Monopole's run database, with its saved judge calls and events. Its Scores in CES stay.

actions.name: rerun
actions.title: Rerun
actions.description: Starts a new run, given --item <run id>, with that run's sessions and settings under the current catalogs; turns added to those sessions since join it. Scoring starts at once and writes Scores to CES; with Continue automatically, judging calls the judge models. Refuses when a model or rubric left the catalog. Needs Monopole's server.

actions.name: continue
actions.title: Continue
actions.description: Starts the stage a run waits for, given --item <run id>: scoring for a draft that is set up, judging after scoring, or reflection after judging, for a run that doesn't continue automatically. Judging and reflection call the judge, proposal-writer, and evaluator models. Needs Monopole's server.

actions.name: create-run
actions.title: Start a new run
actions.description: Starts a new run from New run's settings, given as one JSON argument {selection, config, auto_run}. Scoring starts at once and writes Scores to CES. Needs Monopole's server.

actions.name: catalog
actions.title: Models and rubrics
actions.description: Prints the models and rubrics a new run can choose, from Monopole's server. Reads only.

actions.name: sessions
actions.title: List sessions
actions.description: Prints the sessions a new run can choose, given optional --since, --until, --timezone, and --limit, from Monopole's server. Reads CES only.

actions.name: trends
actions.title: Trends
actions.description: Prints the score summaries, trends over time, A/B leaderboard by configuration, and coaching that Monopole's web UI shows under Analysis, from Monopole's server. Reads CES only; on a large Dataset it takes minutes.

actions.name: session-estimates
actions.title: Session sizes
actions.description: Prints judging token estimates for the given session IDs, which New run's capacity hints read, from Monopole's server. Reads CES only.

actions.name: providers
actions.title: Last provider check
actions.description: Prints the last provider sign-in check, and the last or waiting sign-in, as JSON. Reads files only.

actions.name: check-providers
actions.title: Check providers
actions.description: Checks whether Claude, Codex, and Devin are signed in with their status commands, and whether the W&B and OpenAI keys work with GET /models. Calls no model and spends nothing.

actions.name: sign-in
actions.title: Sign in
actions.description: Runs the CLI's own login command, given --item claude, codex, or devin, and waits for the browser sign-in to finish, at most 10 min; then checks every provider again. --item codex --device-auth runs codex login --device-auth, which shows a link and a one-time code to enter there. Starting codex login removes the current Codex login, even if you cancel.

actions.name: sign-in-code
actions.title: Send sign-in code
actions.description: Types a code pasted from the browser, given --item <provider> --code <code>, into the waiting sign-in.

actions.name: sign-in-cancel
actions.title: Cancel sign-in
actions.description: Stops the waiting sign-in, given --item <provider>.

actions.name: stage-key
actions.title: Hand over API key
actions.description: Holds a W&B or OpenAI key, given --item wandb|openai and --key <key>, unchecked in a file only you can read in Monopole's state folder, for the set-key that follows, and exits at once, so the key stays in the process list only briefly. Never prints the key.

actions.name: set-key
actions.title: Save API key
actions.description: Takes the key stage-key held, given --item wandb|openai, and deletes the held copy; checks it with the free GET /v1/models, then saves it: W&B in ~/.netrc's api.wandb.ai entry, OpenAI in Monopole's state folder, after which Monopole's server restarts to use it unless a run is mid-stage. Never prints the key.

actions.name: score
actions.title: Score recent sessions
actions.description: Writes deterministic Scores to CES for turns from the last --hours 24 or 168 that lack them, as `weave-agent-signals score` does.

actions.name: backfill
actions.title: Backfill a date range
actions.description: Writes every Scorer a turn, session, or subagent from --start to --end (dates, inclusive) lacks to CES, as `weave-agent-signals backfill` does.

actions.name: monitor
actions.title: Check for regressions
actions.description: Checks for significant score regressions now, as `weave-agent-signals monitor` does, and posts new alerts to the webhook in settings, if any.

actions.name: insights
actions.title: Insight table
actions.description: Prints one of analyze's insight tables, given --kind subagents, judges, or segments. Reads CES only.

actions.name: tools
actions.title: Last tool runs
actions.description: Prints each tool's last run and whether it is still running. Reads files only.

actions.name: get-settings
actions.title: Read settings
actions.description: Prints the settings as JSON.

actions.name: save-settings
actions.title: Save settings
actions.description: Checks the changed settings and saves them in Monopole's state folder.
